authorship: Text and drawing code drafted for Mantel with AI assistance (Claude); a person reviews every pack before it is approved (plan D26).
narration: None. eSpeak NG, the only voice the plan allows (D26), was not installed where the pack was drawn; the cards are text-first and silent.

sources.supports: Clock geometry: the minute hand turns 6 degrees a minute and the hour hand 30 degrees an hour, so at half past it is halfway between two numbers. Computed, not copied: see clock() above.
English and Bulgarian ways of saying the time (o'clock / часа, half past / и половина, quarter past / и четвърт, quarter to / без четвърт): ordinary language, for a fluent reader to confirm.

method: SVG drawn by draw.py, rasterised by rsvg-convert, re-encoded by Pillow as an 8-bit palette PNG with no metadata chunks. Original work: no image-generation model, stock or third-party artwork.
